evidence: The Croesus Track crosses the Paparoa Range between Blackball in the Grey Valley and Barrytown on the Tasman Sea Coast.
It's recommended to walk from Smoke-ho carpark in the east to Barrytown in the west.
Go up this gravel road to Smoke-ho car park and to the start of Croesus Track.

Croesus Knob Route

doubts: The Smoke-ho car park start is reached by Croesus Track Road, but no road end feature is on that road (F1 is an unnamed track on Blackball Road), so the start ref is null. End ref F2 (where the Croesus Track meets Coast Road) assumed to be the Barrytown end on the Tasman Sea Coast. The text recommends east to west but implies it can be walked either way. Where the Garden Gully junction lies on the way is not stated. Croesus Top Hut is passed but cannot be stayed in; listed in huts since the way passes it.
